name: feature.accessibility.nodes
description: Accessibility node pack (ADR 0363) — check authored content for WCAG issues (missing image alt text, skipped heading levels, non-descriptive link text, low color contrast) and generate AI alt text for a media asset, both over ctx.features.accessibility. Enables workflows to gate publishing on zero blocking a11y issues or auto-alt-text a media library.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Accessibility: Check Content
nodes.description: Runs the shared content-accessibility rules over an inline normalized model via ctx.features.accessibility.checkContent. Inputs: { images?, headings?, links?, colorPairs? }. Output: { issues: [{ kind, severity, wcag, nodeRef? }], count }.

nodes.label: Accessibility: Generate Alt Text
nodes.description: Generates AI alt text for an image media asset via ctx.features.accessibility.generateAltText (composes the ADR 0108 vision seam; media enforces IDOR + provider-absence). Inputs: { orgId, assetId }. Output: { assetId, altText } (empty altText = decorative).
